messages:
Maria (Marketing): Quick sync — we want to publish the release announcement next Wed. Need final changelog, docs links, canary window, and a short benchmark callout for the blog. Who can confirm?
Alex M: I can finalize the blog blurb. Where's the latest changelog? pinging eng.
Sanjay (Eng): changelog PR is here: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/412 — still needs one line about the kv-cache fix. Canary window proposal: Tue 03:00–06:00 UTC and Wed 03:00–06:00 UTC (low traffic). Model fallback policy will be enabled by default. :white_check_mark:
Emily (PM): Confirming webinar is scheduled Thu 17:00 PT; marketing needs hero benchmark numbers and a 2-sentence summary for slides.
Maria (Marketing): For the benchmark callout we want: p95 latency, cost-per-1k tokens vs our baseline, and a short sentence we can put under the hero. Can you provide asap?
Sanjay (Eng): Quick figures from perf-run: p95 = 48ms (text-gen, 256 tokens), cost delta = -28% vs baseline. Full run output: https://perf.redwood.ai/runs/2026-03-10 — note these are on Dedicated with 4x batching. Use the conservative numbers in marketing (rounding to 50ms, -25%).
Alex M: Copy note received. I'll write the hero line and slide sentence. Also need the final docs link for migration + an embed config snippet.
Sanjay (Eng): Docs landing page will be https://docs.redwood.ai/release/2026-03-v1 — migration guide PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/410 . Please link to section 3 for the config snippet (it has the sample autoscale and kv-cache toggles).
Maria (Marketing): Inbound routing — leads coming from the announcement should go to the SF demo queue and the Enterprise SDR list. Emily, can you confirm Zap/HubSpot tags?
Emily (PM): Routing sheet updated and ops notified. Zapier flow set: announcement -> demo-form -> sales-queue-demo. Enterprise leads will be tagged "enterprise-release" in HubSpot. I’ll run a QA pass tomorrow at 10:30 PT.
Deploy Bot: Release canary scheduled: Tue 03:00 UTC. Canary job created by @Sanjay (Eng). Status: pending.
Alex M: Draft post is in /marketing/drive/drafts/release-2026-03.md — I’ll push copy by EOD Monday. Maria: any embargos or press holdouts?
Maria (Marketing): No external embargo; partner-only notice list (shared in drive). Final ask: engineering please freeze changelog content by 09:00 Tue so marketing can preview with final links. Can you freeze, @Sanjay?
Sanjay (Eng): Yep — will freeze changelog by 09:00 Tue and add the kv-cache note plus the short benchmark sentence.
Maria (Marketing): Perfect. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
Alex M: One more — can we get a one-line migration checklist for the announcement (3 bullets max)? I’ll paste into the post.
Sanjay (Eng): Will drop 3 bullets into PR #410 by morning: (1) update client to 1.12, (2) enable kv-cache:true for warmups, (3) add fallback:model-compat in route.
Maria (Marketing): Awesome — that covers it. I’ll assemble the post and share for a final quick review Tue 11:00 PT.
Emily (PM): Noted. I’ll validate routing after canary starts.
Deploy Bot: Canary started: Tue 03:05 UTC — health checks passing.
Maria (Marketing): Great — switching to review mode. Thanks all! :tada:
